It is the first dam of the Oujiang River cascade to be constructed and creates the second largest lake in Zhejiang.
Taizhou Railway Station | Taizhou Railway Station (Zhejiang Province) () is a railway station of Yongtaiwen Railway located in Taizhou, Zhejiang, People's Republic of China.
